author: ItsJRgamer323
body:
Minecraft Username: ItsJRgamer323
I was banned because I was in a nebula game, and I was pretty much better than everyone there, I do a lot of pvp in my free-time and practice a lot. So I was in a game with a Moderator and I 10 Heart him. He says "ItsJRgamer323 stop hacking or else you will get banned" and I said, "I'm not hacking". and then he said "Send me a screenshot of your screen" so I did. And he said, "You probably turned off the hacks". And then 2 minutes later, I got this: https://gyazo.com/f2ab7f20e8001a12f505547ac9f2ca57 
I should be unbanned, because that moderator "BenDooley7" Didn't have any proof that I was hacking, I even sent him my screen and he still didn't believe me. I was not hacking, I've never hacked and I never want to. I honestly think this guy shouldn't be mod, I have no hate against him but, he just isn't that great, banning someone for not doing anything. I have been waiting ever sense February 6 of last year!
